# Challenge

`schemas/records/challenge.json`

A single-use human confirmation challenge for a proposal under the human policy (docs/design/m0/04). It is answered only by a WebAuthn assertion on the dashboard (D37) over nonce ‖ binding_digest, and consumed atomically. The nonce is a secret until consumed: logs redact it by type.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [ChallengeID](common-defs.md#challengeid) |  |
| `proposal` | yes | [ProposalID](common-defs.md#proposalid) |  |
| `binding_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |
| `nonce` | yes | string (pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`) | 32 fresh random bytes, lowercase hex. |
| `allowed_confirmers` | yes | array of [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) (minItems `1`, unique items) | Operator actors who may confirm. |
| `expires_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) | Short (default 15 minutes); re-issued on demand. |
| `used_at` | yes | null or [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
